Name: Retro Style Crops for CP and AT
Author: Wildflourmods
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/TVWAHsI.png[/img][/size]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=5]This mod provides retextures (alternative sprites) for the growth sprites for various crops in Stardew Valley! Meant to add a retro feel to pair with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18223]Yri's Retro Recolor[/url], these growth sprites are cute and colorful and also completely configurable! You can turn on and off any of the ones you want via the config file so you can pair this with any other retextures you enjoy using like Vanilla Tweaks or Fancy Crops and Foraging!
[/size]
[b][size=6][center]﻿[b][size=6]WAIT THERE'S MORE!
[/size][/b][/center][/size][/b][size=5]Also included is an AT pack that features other colors for various crops that you would often encounter in real life (and some maybe not).[/size]

[size=5][i]Examples include: [/i][/size][size=5]purple cauliflower, green tomatoes, orange peppers, white pumpkins and more!
[/size]
[size=6][b][center]GIANT CROP VERSIONS AS WELL!

Fill your farm with a multicolored giant crop empire![/center][/b][/size][/color][size=5][color=#f4f4f4]
[i]Note: the following crop stages do [u]not[/u] currently have retextures:
[list]
[*]Pineapple
[*]Taro
[/list][/i][/color][img]https://i.imgur.com/c8QF6DK.png[/img]﻿
[center]Thank you to Bo for their amazing giant pumpkin sprites!

Check them out and commission them here for pixel work or other forms of digital art!!
--> [url=https://boara.carrd.co/]https://boara.carrd.co/[/url]﻿[/center][/size]
[center][size=5]Thank you to 6480 for their open use permissions on their giant crops ! [/size][/center]
[size=5][center]AND a big thank you to the SDV modding discord community - y'all are so lovely and supportive.



[img]https://i.imgur.com/xNiIVBL.png[/img]

Right now there is only one incompatibility I know of and that is with Almanac. If Almanac is installed then changing the color of the giant crops that are not base game (cauliflower, pumpkin and melon) won't apply. [u][i]It only affects the giant crop AT pack, and only the non base game giant crops.
[/i][/u]
I have no idea why and I've let both the authors of AT and Almanac know so if it gets resolved I will update here![/center][/size]
[size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/4JQyssp.png[/img][/size]

[size=5]For the full list check out my user page on Nexus [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/68674623?tab=user+files]HERE[/url][/size][/font]
